name: kb.search
title: Search the knowledge base
description: Searches the know-how pages and, as the fallback when a page is missing or out of date, the user guide's own text, by the words of a question. It returns the best hits, each with its key, title, one-line summary and a snippet, a page or a guide page, ranked; read a page with kb.read. Use the words a person would use. It never returns a page you may not read.

scope.description: pages: the compiled pages; sources: the guide's own text; both, the default.

limit.description: How many hits, at most 10; the default is 5.
